title: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA NGỮ PHÁP CHUYÊN SÂU TOÀN DIỆN (100 CÂU)

parts.partTitle: PHẦN 1: CHIA ĐỘNG TỪ TRONG NGOẶC (CÂU 1 – 25)
parts.instruction: Chia dạng đúng của động từ trong ngoặc để hoàn thành câu:

questions.prompt: The train to London (depart) [blank] at 8:15 every morning from platform 3.
questions.explanation: Lịch trình tàu xe cố định chia Hiện tại đơn.

questions.prompt: Listen! The birds (sing) [blank] so sweetly in the garden.
questions.explanation: Dấu hiệu mệnh lệnh Listen! ➔ chia Hiện tại tiếp diễn.

questions.prompt: My sister is always (lose) [blank] her keys, which annoys everyone.
questions.explanation: Phàn nàn thói quen xấu đi với always ➔ is always losing.

questions.prompt: Yesterday afternoon, I (buy) a new laptop and (bring) it home. ➔ Điền: [blank]
questions.explanation: Quá khứ đơn V2 của buy và bring là bought và brought.

questions.prompt: When the teacher walked into the classroom, the students (quarrel) [blank] loudly.
questions.explanation: Hành động đang diễn ra trong quá khứ thì giáo viên bước vào cắt ngang.

questions.prompt: At 7:00 PM yesterday, while my father was reading a book, my mother (cook) [blank] dinner.
questions.explanation: Hai hành động diễn ra song song trong quá khứ đi kèm while.

questions.prompt: She (never / eat) [blank] sushi before her recent trip to Japan.
questions.explanation: Kinh nghiệm diễn ra trước một mốc quá khứ (her recent trip) ➔ Quá khứ hoàn thành.

questions.prompt: Up to now, our team (complete) [blank] four major scientific projects.
questions.explanation: Dấu hiệu Up to now ➔ chia Hiện tại hoàn thành.

questions.prompt: By the time the fire brigade arrived, the fire (destroy) [blank] half of the building.
questions.explanation: By the time + QKĐ, mệnh đề chính chia Quá khứ hoàn thành.

questions.prompt: After he (finish) [blank] all his homework, he went out to play basketball.
questions.explanation: Hành động xảy ra trước hành động đi chơi sau liên từ After ➔ Quá khứ hoàn thành.

questions.prompt: I believe that she (recover) [blank] from her illness soon.
questions.explanation: Dự đoán tương lai sau động từ believe và trạng từ soon.

questions.prompt: My father (call) [blank] you in 5 minutes.
questions.explanation: Dấu hiệu in 5 minutes (trong 5 phút nữa) ➔ Tương lai đơn.

questions.prompt: If it (not / rain) [blank] this weekend, we will go on a picnic.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề If điều kiện loại 1 chia Hiện tại đơn phủ định.

questions.prompt: If I (be) [blank] in your shoes, I would accept that job offer immediately.
questions.explanation: Điều kiện loại 2 giả định trái ngược hiện tại: to be chia là were.

questions.prompt: If he had driven more carefully yesterday, he (not / crash) [blank] into that tree.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề chính điều kiện loại 3: would have + V3.

questions.prompt: If you had taken your medicine last night, you (feel) [blank] much better right now.
questions.explanation: Điều kiện hỗn hợp 3-2: giả định quá khứ (last night), kết quả hiện tại (right now).

questions.prompt: A new library (build) [blank] in our town since last summer.
questions.explanation: Bị động thì Hiện tại hoàn thành có mốc since last summer.

questions.prompt: Look at those ruins! The old temple (destroy) [blank] by a violent storm last week.
questions.explanation: Bị động Quá khứ đơn có last week.

questions.prompt: This delicious dish (bring) [blank] to our table by the waiter five minutes ago.
questions.explanation: Bị động Quá khứ đơn có five minutes ago.

questions.prompt: The final exam results (announce) [blank] by the school board next Monday.
questions.explanation: Bị động Tương lai đơn có next Monday.

questions.prompt: The lake is frozen. Many children (skate) [blank] on it at the moment.
questions.explanation: Hiện tại tiếp diễn có dấu hiệu at the moment.

questions.prompt: He (work) [blank] for this corporation for twenty years before he retired in 2020.
questions.explanation: Quá khứ hoàn thành xảy ra trước mốc nghỉ hưu năm 2020.

questions.prompt: All the milk in the fridge (already / drink) [blank] by the children.
questions.explanation: Bị động thì Hiện tại hoàn thành có already.

questions.prompt: If people (use) [blank] public transport more, air quality will improve significantly.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề If điều kiện loại 1 chia Hiện tại đơn.

questions.prompt: Unless she (apologize) [blank] to him, he will never speak to her again.
questions.explanation: Sau Unless chia khẳng định thì Hiện tại đơn ngôi she.

parts.partTitle: PHẦN 2: CẤU TẠO TỪ - WORD FORMATION (CÂU 26 – 40)
parts.instruction: Dựa vào ngữ cảnh câu và vị trí ngữ pháp, điền dạng thích hợp của từ trong ngoặc:

questions.prompt: The government is investing heavily in the [educate] [blank] system of rural provinces.
questions.explanation: Tính từ bổ nghĩa cho danh từ system: educational system.

questions.prompt: Using public buses is an [economy] [blank] way to save travel expenses.
questions.explanation: Tính từ mang nghĩa tiết kiệm: economical way.

questions.prompt: The twins look identical, but they behave very [differ] [blank].
questions.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ thường behave: differently.

questions.prompt: He is not academically [qualify] [blank] to teach advanced linguistics.
questions.explanation: Tính từ chỉ đủ trình độ chuyên môn: qualified.

questions.prompt: Her speech was so [impress] [blank] that the entire audience clapped enthusiastically.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc so + adj + that: impressive.

questions.prompt: Industrial waste has severely [pollute] [blank] the local river.
questions.explanation: Dạng V3/ed trong thì Hiện tại hoàn thành: polluted.

questions.prompt: The typhoon caused [destroy] [blank] damage to the coastal fishing village.
questions.explanation: Tính từ bổ nghĩa cho danh từ damage: destructive damage.

questions.prompt: He lost his job last month and has been [employ] [blank] since then.
questions.explanation: Tính từ chỉ tình trạng thất nghiệp: unemployed.

questions.prompt: Wearing áo dài during Tet holiday is a long-standing [culture] [blank] tradition.
questions.explanation: Tính từ thuộc về văn hóa: cultural tradition.

questions.prompt: The sudden cancellation of the concert was completely [expect] [blank] to all fans.
questions.explanation: Tính từ phủ định chỉ sự bất ngờ: unexpected.

questions.prompt: The devastation left behind by the earthquake was almost [imagine] [blank].
questions.explanation: Tính từ phủ định mang nghĩa không tưởng tượng nổi: unimaginable.

questions.prompt: Please read the safety warnings [care] [blank] before operating this device.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ read: carefully.

questions.prompt: He attempted to open the locked chest, but his efforts were totally [succeed] [blank].
questions.explanation: Tính từ phủ định chỉ sự thất bại: unsuccessful.

questions.prompt: Many conservation programs are trying to protect [danger] [blank] animals from extinction.
questions.explanation: Cụm danh từ cố định: endangered animals (động vật có nguy cơ tuyệt chủng).

questions.prompt: His bizarre excuse sounded completely [believe] [blank], so the teacher rejected it.
questions.explanation: Tính từ phủ định mang nghĩa khó tin: unbelievable.

parts.partTitle: PHẦN 3: GIỚI TỪ, MẠO TỪ & LƯỢNG TỪ (CÂU 41 – 65)
parts.instruction: Điền giới từ, mạo từ (a, an, the, Ø) hoặc lượng từ thích hợp:

questions.prompt: The world-famous museum was opened [blank] 1995.
questions.explanation: Trước năm dùng giới từ in.

questions.prompt: The seminar will start promptly [blank] 8:30 AM on Monday morning.
questions.explanation: Trước giờ cụ thể dùng giới từ at.

questions.prompt: Don't sit [blank] the floor; it's very cold. Sit in that armchair.
questions.explanation: Trên bề mặt sàn nhà dùng on the floor.

questions.prompt: My office is located [blank] the third floor of the building.
questions.explanation: Tầng lầu dùng on the third floor.

questions.prompt: We arrived [blank] the airport just in time for our flight.
questions.explanation: Địa điểm xác định: at the airport.

questions.prompt: The technician said the machine would be fixed [blank] 2 hours.
questions.explanation: in + khoảng thời gian = trong vòng bao lâu nữa.

questions.prompt: Jack spends most of his adult life living and working at [blank] sea as a ship captain.
questions.explanation: Thành ngữ at sea không dùng mạo từ.

questions.prompt: Look at [blank] moon! It looks so bright tonight.
questions.explanation: Vật thể duy nhất trong tự nhiên: the moon.

questions.prompt: He wants to become [blank] software engineer in the future.
questions.explanation: Danh từ nghề nghiệp bắt đầu bằng phụ âm: a software engineer.

questions.prompt: Do you usually watch news on [blank] television or browse the Internet?
questions.explanation: Cụm on television không dùng mạo từ.

questions.prompt: She bought [blank] used car yesterday. (Điền a hoặc an)
questions.explanation: used phiên âm bắt đầu bằng phụ âm /ju:/ nên đi với a.

questions.prompt: The government needs to introduce more social welfare programs for [blank] poor.
questions.explanation: the + adj = nhóm người: the poor = người nghèo.

questions.prompt: There are billions of galaxies scattered across [blank] outer space.
questions.explanation: outer space không dùng mạo từ.

questions.prompt: She has [blank] real friends in this city, so she often feels lonely on weekends. (Dùng few / a few)
questions.explanation: Ý nghĩa tiêu cực chỉ sự thiếu thốn, cô đơn: few friends.

questions.prompt: Don't worry! We still have [blank] time left before the train leaves. (Dùng little / a little)
questions.explanation: Ý nghĩa tích cực (còn một chút, đủ dùng): a little time.

questions.prompt: There isn't [blank] salt left in the kitchen cabinet.
questions.explanation: Câu phủ định dùng any.

questions.prompt: Would you like [blank] orange juice while you wait?
questions.explanation: Lời mời lịch sự dùng some.

questions.prompt: [blank] the students in our school enjoy participating in extracurricular activities. (Dùng Most / Most of)
questions.explanation: Đứng trước the students bắt buộc dùng Most of.

questions.prompt: [blank] cars manufactured nowadays are equipped with smart security sensors. (Dùng Most / Most of)
questions.explanation: Đứng trước danh từ số nhiều nói chung dùng Most.

questions.prompt: Learning a foreign language requires a great deal of [blank]. (patience / mistakes)
questions.explanation: a great deal of đi với danh từ không đếm được: patience.

questions.prompt: The curtains do not [blank] the sofa at all. (match / match with)
questions.explanation: match là ngoại động từ trực tiếp, không đi với giới từ with.

questions.prompt: She was so angry that she left the room without saying a word [blank] anyone.
questions.explanation: say a word to someone: nói lời nào với ai.

questions.prompt: They decided to enrol in the training program with a view to [blank] their professional skills. (improve / improving)
questions.explanation: with a view to + V-ing: nhằm mục đích làm gì.

questions.prompt: He gave place [blank] an elderly woman on the crowded bus.
questions.explanation: give place to someone: nhường chỗ cho ai.

questions.prompt: You can take advantage [blank] this discount to buy standard textbooks.
questions.explanation: take advantage of: tận dụng cái gì.

parts.partTitle: PHẦN 4: TRẮC NGHIỆM TỔNG HỢP & BẪY NGỮ PHÁP (CÂU 66 – 85)
parts.instruction: Chọn phương án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D):

questions.prompt: The ________ you practice speaking English, the ________ confident you become.
questions.explanation: So sánh kép: The more... the more...

questions.prompt: This mathematics exercise is ________ than the one we solved yesterday.
questions.explanation: easy ➔ easier, nhấn mạnh bằng much: much easier.

questions.prompt: She danced ________ than any other ballerina at the theatre.
questions.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ danced cần trạng từ: more gracefully.

questions.prompt: The Sears Tower is one of the ________ buildings in North America.
questions.explanation: So sánh nhất tính từ ngắn: the tallest.

questions.prompt: The middle-aged gentleman to ________ my father was talking is a renowned surgeon.
questions.explanation: Giới từ to đứng trước đại từ quan hệ chỉ người ➔ to whom.

questions.prompt: That is the musician ________ latest song hit number one on the charts.
questions.explanation: Chỉ sở hữu: whose latest song (bài hát của nhạc sĩ đó).

questions.prompt: She failed the entrance exam three times, ________ disappointed her entire family.
questions.explanation: Thay thế cho toàn bộ sự việc đứng trước dùng dấu phẩy + which.

questions.prompt: This is the house ________ I spent my childhood years.
questions.explanation: Nơi chốn nơi tôi từng sống ➔ where.

questions.prompt: By the time we ________ at the stadium, the concert ________ for 20 minutes.
questions.explanation: By the time + QKĐ, mệnh đề chính chia QKHT: arrived / had started.

questions.prompt: While Peter ________ his bicycle, a dog ran across the street.
questions.explanation: Hành động đang diễn ra was riding thì hành động cắt ngang chia QKĐ.

questions.prompt: Unless it ________ heavily tomorrow, our school will organize an outdoor sports day.
questions.explanation: Sau Unless chia khẳng định hiện tại đơn: rains.

questions.prompt: If he had checked the weather forecast, he ________ an umbrella with him.
questions.explanation: Điều kiện loại 3 mệnh đề chính: would have brought.

questions.prompt: If I were you, I ________ those toxic chemicals without wearing protective gloves.
questions.explanation: Điều kiện loại 2 mệnh đề chính: wouldn't touch.

questions.prompt: The report ________ thoroughly by the executive board before the meeting began.
questions.explanation: Bị động Quá khứ hoàn thành xảy ra trước before: had been reviewed.

questions.prompt: How many official languages ________ in Singapore?
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi bị động thì Hiện tại đơn: are spoken.

questions.prompt: Turn left at the crossroads and the library will be on ________ right.
questions.explanation: Chỉ hướng: on your right (hoặc on the right).

questions.prompt: ________ Apollo 11 was the first spaceflight that landed humans on the Moon.
questions.explanation: Tên chuyến bay/tàu vũ trụ có số thứ tự thường không dùng mạo từ (Ø).

questions.prompt: Peter drank ________ wine last night, so he has a severe headache today.
questions.explanation: wine không đếm được dùng too much.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with NO grammatical errors:
options: A. The faster you walk, the more tired you get.
B. The more faster you walk, the more tired you get.
C. The fast you walk, the tired you get.
D. The faster you walk, the tiredest you get.
questions.explanation: So sánh kép chuẩn: The faster..., the more tired...

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with INCORRECT preposition usage:
options: A. She is responsible for managing the project.
B. He graduated from Oxford University in 2015.
C. The color of this shirt doesn't match with your trousers.
D. We are looking forward to hearing from you.
questions.explanation: match là ngoại động từ trực tiếp, không dùng match with.

parts.partTitle: PHẦN 5: BÀI TẬP DIỄN ĐẠT & VIẾT LẠI CÂU (CÂU 86 – 100)
parts.instruction: Viết lại câu theo đúng cấu trúc hoặc chủ điểm ngữ pháp yêu cầu:

questions.prompt: Tình huống: My mother cleans our living room every morning. (Dùng Câu bị động)
answers: is cleaned by my mother every morning.
is cleaned every morning by my mother.
questions.explanation: Bị động Hiện tại đơn: is cleaned by my mother every morning.

questions.prompt: Tình huống: The workers are repairing the road outside our house right now. (Bị động Hiện tại tiếp diễn)
answers: is being repaired by the workers right now.
is being repaired right now by the workers.
questions.explanation: Bị động Hiện tại tiếp diễn: is being repaired by the workers right now.

questions.prompt: Tình huống: The secretary didn't send the contract to the manager yesterday. (Bị động Quá khứ đơn)
answers: was not sent to the manager by the secretary yesterday.
wasn't sent to the manager by the secretary yesterday.
wasn't sent to the manager yesterday.
questions.explanation: Bị động Quá khứ đơn: was not sent to the manager by the secretary yesterday.

questions.prompt: Tình huống: Someone has stolen his expensive bicycle from the garage. (Bị động Hiện tại hoàn thành)
answers: has been stolen from the garage.
has been stolen from the garage by someone.
questions.explanation: Bị động Hiện tại hoàn thành: has been stolen from the garage.

questions.prompt: Tình huống: The board of directors will announce the new policy tomorrow. (Bị động Tương lai đơn)
answers: will be announced tomorrow by the board of directors.
will be announced by the board of directors tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Bị động Tương lai đơn: will be announced tomorrow by the board of directors.

questions.prompt: Tình huống: Hurry up, or you will be late for school. (Dùng If hoặc Unless)
answers: don't hurry up, you will be late for school.
do not hurry up, you will be late for school.
questions.explanation: If loại 1: If you don't hurry up, you will be late for school.

questions.prompt: Tình huống: I don't have his phone number, so I can't call him for advice. (Dùng Câu điều kiện loại 2)
answers: had his phone number, I could call him for advice.
had his phone number, I would be able to call him for advice.
questions.explanation: If loại 2 (ngược hiện tại): If I had his phone number, I could call him for advice.

questions.prompt: Tình huống: She didn't study hard for the final exam, so she failed it last week. (Dùng Câu điều kiện loại 3)
answers: had studied hard for the final exam, she wouldn't have failed it.
had studied hard for the final exam, she would not have failed it.
questions.explanation: If loại 3 (ngược quá khứ): If she had studied hard for the final exam, she wouldn't have failed it.

questions.prompt: Tình huống: He stayed up all night playing games yesterday, so he feels exhausted right now. (Điều kiện hỗn hợp 3-2)
answers: hadn't stayed up all night playing games yesterday, he wouldn't feel exhausted right now.
had not stayed up all night playing games yesterday, he would not feel exhausted right now.
questions.explanation: Điều kiện hỗn hợp 3-2: If he hadn't stayed up all night..., he wouldn't feel exhausted right now.

questions.prompt: Tình huống: The woman is a famous doctor. You spoke to her on the phone yesterday. (Dùng Mệnh đề quan hệ)
answers: whom you spoke to on the phone yesterday is a famous doctor.
to whom you spoke on the phone yesterday is a famous doctor.
that you spoke to on the phone yesterday is a famous doctor.
who you spoke to on the phone yesterday is a famous doctor.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ chỉ người: The woman whom you spoke to on the phone yesterday is a famous doctor.

questions.prompt: Tình huống: I bought a new car last month. Its engine runs very smoothly. (Dùng đại từ whose)
answers: a new car whose engine runs very smoothly last month.
a new car last month whose engine runs very smoothly.
questions.explanation: whose chỉ sở hữu đồ vật: a new car whose engine runs very smoothly.

questions.prompt: Tình huống: Max was late for the final interview. That made his parents very disappointed. (Dùng which thay cả mệnh đề)
questions.targetStart: Max was late for the final interview,
answers: which made his parents very disappointed.
which disappointed his parents a lot.
questions.explanation: , which thay thế cho cả sự việc đứng trước.

questions.prompt: Tình huống: No one in our basketball club is taller than David. (So sánh nhất với David làm chủ ngữ)
answers: tallest person in our basketball club.
tallest player in our basketball club.
tallest member in our basketball club.
questions.explanation: So sánh nhất: David is the tallest person in our basketball club.

questions.prompt: Tình huống: When you read more books, you gain more useful knowledge. (Dùng cấu trúc The more..., the more...)
answers: the more useful knowledge you gain.
questions.explanation: So sánh kép: The more books you read, the more useful knowledge you gain.

questions.prompt: Tình huống: She finished her work at the office. Then she went home to have dinner with her family. (Dùng Before)
answers: finished her work at the office before she went home to have dinner with her family.
questions.explanation: Quá khứ hoàn thành trước Before: She had finished her work at the office before she went home...
